2609.29448.title: YODAS v3: Over 1 Million Hours of High-Bandwidth, Stereophonic, Multilingual Speech
2609.29448.paper_summary: We present YODAS v3, a weakly-labeled speech corpus containing over 1.1 million hours of 48kHz multi-channel audio in 147 languages, released under a CC BY 3.0 license. YODAS v3 is not only the largest open speech dataset to date, but also the first truly large-scale speech corpus with high-fidelity stereo audio. We first provide the collection methodology for the corpus, where we introduce new techniques for gathering language-balanced speech data. The effectiveness of our approach is shown by the language distribution of the crawled data: 22 languages in YODAS v3 have over 10K hours and 73 languages have over 5K hours of data. We then conduct extensive analyses on the composition of the data, such as the distribution of languages, audio quality, and transcription quality. Finally, we train baseline speech recognition and neural codec models to show the effectiveness of the dataset. Download at https://huggingface.co/datasets/espnet/yodas3.
2609.29448.paper_summary_zh: 我們推出 YODAS v3，這是一個弱標記的語音語料庫，包含超過 110 萬小時的 48kHz 多通道音頻，涵蓋 147 種語言，並在 CC BY 3.0 授權下發布。YODAS v3 不僅是迄今為止最大的開放語音數據集，也是第一個真正的大規模高保真立體聲語音語料庫。我們首先提供語料庫的收集方法，並介紹了收集語言平衡語音數據的新技術。我們的方法的有效性通過爬取數據的語言分佈得以顯示：YODAS v3 中有 22 種語言的數據超過 10K 小時，73 種語言的數據超過 5K 小時。接著，我們對數據的組成進行了廣泛的分析，例如語言分佈、音頻質量和轉錄質量。最後，我們訓練了基線語音識別和神經編解碼模型，以展示數據集的有效性。下載地址為 https://huggingface.co/datasets/espnet/yodas3。
